limits: Inherited arrays retain one complete owner. Missing stages or relic quality remain unknown.
Relic reward-manifest identities are links, not decoded reward tables or reward probabilities.
Relic ERA/CATEGORY placeholders use explicit same-region language tags, retaining template and arguments; missing arguments produce null, never a resource-name guess.
Ability metadata and arcane rank/compatibility metadata are not complete scripted combat mechanics.
Booster pack probability and rarity fields are raw native inputs, not normalized final drop chances. Focus metadata does not evaluate scripted rank effects.
Job manifests retain ordered candidate pools and tier reward identities; the selection algorithm and reward probabilities are separate inputs.
Challenge display keys follow JobLib, not generator deduplication; localized candidates require the board-specific prefix binding. RequiredCount is not inferred when absent.
Syndicate alignments and titles retain their complete declaring owner; absence is not zero or an empty array.

The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.

zh.description:
灵煞舰队正以惊人的数量从面纱比邻星域中涌现。

横跨整个星系，天诺战士与他们意想不到的盟友，发动了最终强袭以攻占灵煞母舰。而娜塔……亦在舰中严阵以待。

en.description:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
en.name: Vor's Prize

zh.description:
我尊敬的女皇们——

你们是正确的，天诺的威胁千真万确。我们找到一个天诺漂浮在地球附近，但莲事先料到了我们的行动。就在我们要抓住天诺之前，莲解除了冷冻睡眠，并派来一支天诺小队破坏了我们的攻势。

他们逃跑了。我们正在追踪。只要将这个天诺与大部队分开，就应该很容易干掉。我们已经击碎了其战甲外甲，并且如此突然地解除冷冻将对其记忆力造成损伤。

由于未能完成任务，我们不胜惶恐地等待应得的惩罚。

——沃尔
zh.name: 沃尔的战利品
